description.p: Get, remove and update Elder Scrolls Online (ESO) add-ons from ESOUI.com.

ul.li: Access the ESOUI.com library of addons and download them straight to your game's addon folder
Scans your addon folder to keep track of addons installed through any means and searches for updates
Automatically installs AddOn dependencies and, if configured, optional dependencies
Detects unused library AddOns and can clean them all up
Keeps a tab of nested/bundled addons and libraries, which copy is most recent, and whether there are newer versions as satandalone addons
Can clean up saved variables of addons on removal
Can persist local edits made to addons across updates by saving them as patches
Displays all recent changes it performed

description.p: Gru is an independent, unofficial tool, not affiliated with ZeniMax Online Studios, Bethesda Softworks or MMOUI.
